[[File:Robbie Hendon (community card).jpg|thumb|right|220px|Robbie Hendon, from the community card ''Robbie H''.]]
'''Robbie Hendon''' (GEMP handle '''rhendon''')<ref name="roster">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=81218 SWCCG Teams - Rosters], Joe Olson (21 July 2022; spreadsheet updated 14 September 2025). [[:File:SWCCG Teams Rosters 14 September 2025.txt]]; [https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit Google Sheet]; Wayback [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008235350/https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1sm2eRljZ3MNMBMPCJpADTFzFXbuy5jjfVrTb9BCzBC4/edit?usp=sharing 8 October 2026]</ref> is a member of the [[Killer Bees]]<ref name="slack-kb">Star Wars CCG Slack, #swccgdiscussion, Garrett Larson (deadbody), Dan Tartaglione (DTartagOne), Robbie Hendon. Quotes: "Me and Dan and Robbie"; Hendon wrote that he is on Killer Bees; Tartaglione posted "The Killer Bee's Suite is open" at 2024 Worlds</ref>. He finished '''#7''' at the [[2024 Supreme Southern Showdown]].<ref name="pc-2024SupremeSouthernShowdown" /> Hendon also finished '''#27''' at the [[2026 Tenth Annual GEMPC]] (Lost Round of 32; Challonge seed 28).<ref name="pc-gempc">[https://www.starwarsccg.org/2026-06-tenth-annual-gempc-may-to-july-2026/ 2026-06 Tenth Annual GEMPC], starwarsccg.org</ref><ref name="challonge">[https://challonge.com/18vokbxb Challonge 18vokbxb]</ref>
